subject.title: [Feature]: Inbound media shared across all agents — no per-agent isolation

question: What should the durable inbound-media isolation boundary and compatibility model be across agents, accounts, sessions, tenants, channels, and explicit sharing?
rationale: The remaining work changes a security-sensitive media-reference contract and can either leave cross-agent gaps or break existing flat managed-media behavior without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define Scoped Contract First
options.body: Choose the identity, compatibility behavior, and explicit sharing semantics before implementation changes storage and staging.

options.title: Implement Account Scoping
options.body: Use bot/account IDs as the first isolation boundary while accepting that non-1:1 account-to-agent and tenant cases need follow-up.

options.title: Defer Broad Core Change
options.body: Keep channel-specific slices open until a maintainer sponsors the cross-channel core media-isolation design.

recommendation.title: Define Scoped Contract First
recommendation.body: Choose the identity, compatibility behavior, and explicit sharing semantics before implementation changes storage and staging.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across media references, media store behavior, sandbox staging, and the earlier broad-tracker review.
